notes: **iCloud Sync.** Your palettes, themes and mood boards, images included, on every Mac you use. Turn it on in Settings › Sync. It runs through a ColorPickr folder in your own iCloud Drive: no account, and nothing goes to ColorPickr. If the same item changes on two Macs at once, both versions are kept. Part of ColorPickr Pro.
